messages:
jena.sales: Quick handoff — VerdantTech (mid-market healthcare analytics) started a 30d trial today. Renewal window ~55d. POC: sara@verdanttech.io. Top asks: SSO (SAML) + SCIM, data residency in eu-west-1, audit logs to their SIEM, and lower-cost embedding storage. They flagged cost as a potential blocker.

omar.cs: Ill take CS ownership. Success criteria they gave: 1) SSO + SCIM working, 2) audit delivery >=99% with retries, 3) embeddings retention cost <= $X/mo (they asked for options). Do we have repro for audit delivery failures?

jena.sales: Uploaded initial logs to ticket 77821 — shows webhook 502 intermittently and SCIM provisioning failing with 403 for group sync. Sara says theyre risk-averse on Private; will consider Dedicated if region+KMS ok.

miko.support: Picking up ticket #77821. Quick triage: webhook 502 at our collector during peak bursts; retry backoff missing on their side + our 30s timeout kills some long requests. SCIM 403 looks like missing service-account role; sending repro steps to POC. Short-term ask: increase timeout and add server-side retry for webhooks.

tara.eng: cc @miko.support @omar.cs  I can scope. If we add server-side retries + extend timeout to 90s: config change ~12h and can be rolled to staging. If the SIEM requires streaming, thats a larger change (48-72h). For SCIM provisioning, need the exact request + headers to reproduce 403.

omar.cs: Action owners: CS=@omar.cs, Support=@miko.support, Eng=@tara.eng, Sales=@jena.sales. Action items: 1) Support attach full reproducible requests + timing to ticket; 2) Eng propose quick config with risk notes; 3) CS confirm residency/KMS requirements and whether Private is mandatory; 4) Sales to hold renewal messaging.

nate.finance: Nate (Finance): Ill draft a 2-option pricing sheet: Dedicated (eu-west-1) vs Private (one-time infra + ongoing) and an embedding-retention tier with cost per 100k vectors. ETA EOD tomorrow.

docs-bot: Note: docs issue created (#DOC-432) — gov/residency checklist needs clearer KMS + SCIM setup.

miko.support: Added curl repro to ticket: ```curl -v -X POST https://webhook.verdanttech.io/ingest -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @audit_sample.json``` — also included timestamps and response dump.

tara.eng: With repro attached I can do a hotfix config patch to increase timeout + retries. Target: patch to staging within 12h, production rollout after smoke tests (~24h). Will post precise ETA after running the repro.

omar.cs: Capture customer sentiment: Sara said pricing is "surprising" for retention; quoted lower numbers from competitors. Also asked for a simple onboarding checklist and an Enablement call before EOD to walk SCIM/KMS steps.

jena.sales: Booked an enablement slot for tomorrow 11:00 CET. I told Sara were not committing to Private yet but will share the two-option estimate.

miko.support: Ticket-bot: #77821 created, SLA flagged 24h. :rotating_light:

omar.cs: Next check-in 11:30 CET tomorrow (post enablement). Ill update thread with repro status, eng ETA, and finance estimate. Tagging owners: @tara.eng @miko.support @jena.sales @nate.finance. :thumbsup:
